messages.subject: Re: Difference between vector and real array
parts:
Definitely check out chapter 4 as Daniel recommends, but here's the gist: you can use vector/matrix algebra with vectors but not 1-D arrays and you can put integers into 1-D arrays but not vectors. Other than that there aren't really any important differences in one dimension. Once you get to matrices vs 2-D arrays there are additional things to consider related to memory, storage, etc (also discussed in chapter 4). 

Hope that helps, 

Jonah
